next.reason: 1985 defines At End: 'A sequential READ statement was unsuccessfully executed as a result of an at end condition.' §2023:9.1.13.1 repeats it word for word, as prose with no catalog row. Catalogued carriers: status 10 for the at end causes (§2023:9.1.13.4 GR1), 'the at end condition exists' on a sequential READ (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR21), and 'When the at end condition exists, execution of the READ statement is unsuccessful' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR24). The definition is unchanged; the added PREVIOUS cause changes the status-10 list (recorded on 1985-GR-VII.1.3.5-L2.2), not what an at end condition is.
